shortTermObjectives.sto: Remain dry in a 3-hour period by following a toileting schedule

taskAnalysis: Recognize the Need to Wipe – The child should understand when wiping is necessary (e.g., after defecating).
Remain Seated – Stay seated on the toilet to prevent messes and maintain balance.
Reach Behind – Using the dominant hand, reach behind the body between the legs or around the back.
First Wipe – Gently wipe from front to back (for hygiene and to avoid infection).
Check the Paper – Look at the toilet paper to see if it is dirty.
Dispose of the Paper – Drop the used toilet paper into the toilet.
Repeat Wiping – Take fresh toilet paper, fold it, and repeat wiping until the paper is clean after wiping.
Flush the Toilet – Ensure all toilet paper is in the bowl before flushing.
Pull Up Clothes – Adjust underwear and pants properly.
